When someone asks for a handover, read the authoring guide below. Inspect the project they give you and preserve any existing handover. Draft what the evidence supports, then ask the researcher one question at a time about the gaps. Deliver an editable `HANDOVER.md` that opens in the web form. All questions are optional.

{{ with (site.GetPage "/about").Params.team }}The team behind this field guide is {{ delimit . ", " " and " }}. Credit the contributors to the researcher’s own project in their handover.{{ end }}

## Make a handover

- [Interview and authoring guide]({{ .instructions.Permalink }}): Current prompts, Speedrun, file format, worked example and final checks.
- [Questionnaire data]({{ .questions.Permalink }}): Ordered chapters, stable IDs, canonical wording, help, examples and format version.
- [Markdown writer and reader]({{ .writer.Permalink }}): Optional standalone JavaScript module used by the website. Runs locally.
